edits.new: Record exactly one open-ended counterexample question per direction, naming both nodes and describing a concrete potential case. Choose an applicable parent identity or consumer restriction not explicit in the child's meaning before any other condition. Put an entity outside that required identity, or a consumer outside the required class, in the role the restriction constrains. State the attempted violation in the question even if you expect a necessary child implication to rule it out; assess that implication in the answer rather than selecting an already-qualifying entity or a different condition. Otherwise choose another absent qualification; if none applies, test a shared condition or permitted topic connection. Attempt to preserve every child requirement. The question establishes neither admission nor exclusion.
edits.old: Record exactly one open-ended counterexample question per direction, naming both nodes and describing a concrete potential case. The case must attempt to lack an applicable parent restriction absent from the child's explicit wording, rather than already satisfy it. Choose an identity or consumer restriction first, then another absent qualification; if none applies, test a shared condition or permitted topic connection. Apply the chosen restriction to the entity or role it constrains. The case is a test, not a claim that admission or exclusion holds.
